terms.definition: Machine-readable semantic, governance, evidence, and source facts used to produce and validate human-facing project state.
A proposed SW2 execution unit in which all generators and validators consume the same candidate facts rather than rescanning independently.
A proposed dependency graph that executes each required validation fact once per candidate snapshot and reuses proven prerequisites.
Complete structural or acceptance data retained for verification even when a human-facing representation is simplified.
A bounded, semantic representation designed for comprehension without weakening the underlying machine evidence.
